dish.title: Classic Cobb Salad with Seared Chicken, Bacon, Egg, and Blue Cheese
dish.description: Crisp romaine arranged in rows of sliced pan-seared chicken, crisp bacon, hard-cooked eggs, avocado, cherry tomatoes, and crumbled blue cheese, dressed with a sharp red-wine and Dijon vinaigrette.

recipe_version.title: Classic Cobb Salad with Seared Chicken, Bacon, Egg, and Blue Cheese
recipe_version.description: Crisp romaine arranged in rows of sliced pan-seared chicken, crisp bacon, hard-cooked eggs, avocado, cherry tomatoes, and crumbled blue cheese, dressed with a sharp red-wine and Dijon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.note: about 1 1/2 lb, halved horizontally into cutlets

ingredients.name: thick-cut bacon
ingredients.display_name: thick-cut bacon strips whose label lists pork, salt, sugar, and curing agents only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Halve the chicken breasts horizontally and season with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper. Chop the romaine, halve the tomatoes, and snip the chives. Grate the garlic. Shake the vinegar, Dijon, garlic, 7 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper in a jar.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.body: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a 3-quart saucepan. Lower in the eggs and cook at a gentle boil 10 minutes, then move them to a bowl of ice to cool for 5 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 and 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.body: Lay the bacon in a cold 12-inch skillet and cook over medium, turning, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Drain on towels and pour off all but 1 tbsp fat.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Add 1 tbsp olive oil to the skillet and raise the heat to medium-high. Sear the chicken until golden and it reads 165 F, about 4 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Slice and arrange
steps.body: Peel and quarter the eggs, slice the chicken, crumble the bacon, and dice the avocado. Spread the romaine on a platter and arrange the chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomatoes, and blue cheese in neat rows on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Scatter the chives and drizzle with some of the vinaigrette; pass the rest.

equipment: small jar or bowl for vinaigrette
